basic_info.description: 1090 Jackson Street is a 7-unit multifamily property in the Nob Hill District of San Francisco.    The property features a unit mix of seven 1-bedroom/1-bathroom units. Select units have been modestly updated with modern appliances and laminate or refurbished hardwood flooring. Each unit has separate gas and electric meters. Recent upgrades include an updated fire alarm system and a new roof installed in 2020.    Nob Hill is a prestigious and historic San Francisco neighborhood boasting grand architecture, upscale character, and panoramic city views. Known for opulent homes, historic landmarks, and a timeless luxury, it's ideal for those seeking a refined residential environment. Renowned hotels like the Fairmont and the Mark Hopkins, along with historic cable car lines, add to its charm and convenience.    The investment appeal of this property is its excellent Nob Hill location and upside potential in rents.
